items.title: Bee unveils two AI note-taking devices, its first new products since being acquired by Amazon

items.lede: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.
items.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75

items.lede: Last year, Amazon bought Bee, a relatively unknown startup with a $50 always-listening AI wearable that summarized every conversation you had.
